_about: visit.fonterra.com — AEM SPA (React) 'Virtual Visit': 6 stage pages built from virtualvisit/components/content/* (cross-checked against /content/virtualvisit/global/en.model.json :type values). Each stage is a horizontally-scrolling parallax experience — a page-level custom interaction regardless of block mapping.

stage-menu.rationale: Onboarding / journey launcher (virtualvisit/content/stagemenu): full-screen intro with logo, title, copy and a menu of the 5 stages + audio toggle. Bespoke immersive entry screen — custom block.

stage-intro.rationale: Stage opener (stageintro): full-screen background <video> with gradient, stage title and copy → Hero (video-background variant). Visited-state + stage progress nav are handled by the custom page script.

section-divider.rationale: Panel heading with SVG icon between stage chapters (sectiondivider, 21 instances) → default content heading in its own section (icon via section style).

fast-facts.rationale: Animated count-up statistics (numbers animate from 0), expandable fact panels (aria-expanded + role=region) beside an interactive NZ map with plotted sites/regions (fastfacts). No standard equivalent — custom block (counter animation + map).

meet-the-people.rationale: Profile cards (image, name, copy, play/read button opening a modal) inside a stage-intro style panel (meetthepeople) → Cards with modal links.

did-you-know.rationale: 'Things to know' Q&A: list of question hotspots each opening an answer panel with its own slick image carousel (26 buttons, data-index). Interactive explorer — custom block (could be built on Accordion + Carousel, but the layout/interaction is bespoke).

sustainability-commitments.rationale: Full-bleed photo with positioned hotspot tags (Coal, Emissions, Water, Landfill) that reveal commitment details → custom image-hotspots block.

timeline.rationale: Horizontal parallax timeline (is-parallax--bg-fixed): sequence of dated items with images and expand buttons scrolling sideways → custom timeline block.

video-page.rationale: Full-bleed video teaser with title opening a video player (contextual cursor) → Video (placeholder + modal).

end-of-stage.rationale: End-of-stage panel: stage title + 'Continue exploring' list linking to the other stages (data-active state) → small custom stage-navigation block (shares logic with stage-menu).

header.rationale: Stage nav bar (React nav, not an AEM header XF): home + volume buttons and in-stage chapter links (Intro, Fast Facts, Did you know?, …) with scroll-spy → custom EDS header behaviour.

responsivegrid.rationale: SPA responsive grid = the stage page body. NOTE: the horizontal-scroll / parallax stage engine and background audio player are page-level custom JavaScript (not a block) and must be rebuilt for EDS.
